next.name: North Miami Beach City Commission

schedule.note: POSTPONED per the city calendar (Conference 5:00 p.m. and CRA 4:00 p.m. also postponed); no new date posted as of 2026-10-23

next.pattern: The city calendar shows a monthly cycle on a Tuesday (September 15 and October 20, 2026 were the third Tuesday): CRA Board 4:00 p.m., City Commission Conference 5:00 p.m., City Commission Meeting 6:00 p.m., City Hall Commission Chamber, 17011 NE 19th Avenue. The city's meetings page says conference start times vary with the agenda. Broadcast on Comcast 77 and streamed on NMBTV.

levers.how: Speak at the Public Comment portion of the Commission Meeting or on a public hearing item. The Commission does not discuss matters raised under Public Comment; a commissioner can bring your item back as a recommendation at a later meeting.
levers.rules: Three-minute limit per speaker at all public hearings. Longer matters: arrange a meeting with the appropriate official. No sign-up procedure is posted.

levers.how: No written comment procedure is posted. Email the City Clerk.
Call or visit the Offices of the Mayor and City Commission, 4th floor of City Hall.
